title.hr: Zašto ubrzani naboj zrači: silnice koje se lome
title.en: Why an accelerated charge radiates: field lines that kink

concept.hr: Vijest o guranju putuje brzinom c i lomi silnice; lom pada kao 1/r: zračenje
concept.en: News of a push travels out at c and kinks the field lines; the kink falls as 1/r

summary.hr: Gurni, zaustavi ili zatitraj naboj na žici i gledaj lom silnica kako putuje van. Sonde na 4 i 8 m: poprečno polje pada kao 1/r, radijalno kao 1/r².
summary.en: Kick, stop or oscillate a charge on a wire and watch the kink travel out. Probes at 4 and 8 m: the transverse field falls as 1/r, the radial as 1/r².
